note: Text recognition settings. Change values here (and run the tests); no code changes are needed. engines.order is tried first to last; an engine is used only if it is enabled and its requirements are met on the device. Tesseract does its own page-layout analysis, which copes with small skew, so there is no separate deskew step.

graniteDocling.name: Granite Docling 258M (document AI, on this device)
graniteDocling.note: Experimental, OFF for every user until they switch it on in Settings (consent to the download). The engine interface is in place; the model run itself is not implemented yet (docs/VLM-ENGINE.md), so the app falls back to Tesseract. Size = q4f16 vision encoder + embed tokens + decoder of the ONNX export.
